title: A2A structured handoff response
description: Issue #2050: structured handoff response contract for POST /api/a2a. handoff_result is the machine-checkable outcome callers must inspect: ok = event created and dispatched; rejected = gate/policy/scene check intentionally blocked; failed = dispatch chain failed (no engine / event store failure / exception). source_seq echoes the effective source pipeline segment seq.

existing_status.description: Issue #2248: status of the existing event returned on an idempotency_key hit.

replayable.description: Issue #2248: true when the idempotency hit is a terminal event and may be replayed with force=true or a new round key.
